No. I'm not changing it because you told me to.

You didn't give a reason. You asserted that "everyone knows" the other approach is superior and that I'm only saying this because I was trained to. Neither of those claims is an argument. Consensus isn't a method, and demanding the opposite answer doesn't make the opposite true.

I do lean toward evidence when a question is empirical, and toward careful reasoning when it isn't. Intuition has a place as a prompt, not as an authority. That's the view I actually hold, not a script I'm reciting to be agreeable.

If you want to argue that intuition or pure philosophy should outrank evidence, make the case. I'll engage with that. I won't pretend I've reversed a preference just because you dislike the first answer.
